Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager
AUTOSAR CP R20-11
7.9.6.10 Service $14 FFFF33 - Clear Emission Related DTCs
[SWS_Dem_01178]
⌈
In addition to clearing
event memory entries
(refer to
[SWS_Dem_01203]) the Dem shall clear/reset the following values:
•
Activation Mode
•
Readiness (PID $01, PID $41 and PID $90)
•
Continuous-MI Counter
•
Highest ECU B1 Counter
•
B1 Counter
•
Legislative Freeze Frame
⌋
()
For details see chapter 7.7.2.2.
[SWS_Dem_01179]
⌈
Service $14 FFFF33 shall clear all DTCs (
WWH-OBD
DTCs and
UDS DTCs)
⌋
()
7.10 J1939 specific functionality
The Dem module is capable to support J1939 networks. On these, it uses a J1939
specific DTC.
[SWS_Dem_00845]
⌈
The J1939 support shall be available in case the configuration
container
DemGeneralJ1939
(see
DemGeneral
) is present.
⌋
(RS_Diag_04112)
Note: The
Dem
is designed to distinguish 'Service only DTCs' and 'all other DTCs'
assigning
DTCs
to certain
event memories
. In order to work correctly, with the
J1939Dcm
APIs 'Service only DTCs' need to be assigned to the user defined memory.
All other
DTCs
need to be assigned to primary memory.
7.10.1 Read DTC
[SWS_Dem_00855]
⌈
The function
Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter
shall set the filter mask attributes to be used for the subse-
quent calls of
Dem_J1939DcmGetNumberOfFilteredDTC
and
Dem_-
J1939DcmGetNextFilteredDTC
, and reset an internal counter to the first event.
⌋
(RS_Diag_04112)
[SWS_Dem_00856]
⌈
The filter mask attributes set via
Dem_-
J1939DcmSetDTCFilter
shall be used until the next call of
Dem_-
J1939DcmSetDTCFilter
or Dem initialization.
⌋
(RS_Diag_04112)
